headline: BOS @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 4.18 at TBR 3.64, with a projected total of 7.83. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: BOS moved -0.32 runs while TBR moved -0.47, changing the projected margin by +0.15 runs. The projected total fell -0.79, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Ian Seymour has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yandy Díaz, Ceddanne Rafaela, Junior Caminero, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Oliver Dunn, Chandler Simpson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
